about.title: About Arkaya
about.description: Arkaya Arge Yazılım İnşaat Ticaret Limited Şirketi is a software company based in Isparta, Türkiye. We build cloud-based SaaS applications for the occupational health & safety industry, along with corporate network security solutions.
about.description2: Instead of taking on project-based software work, we focus on our own products: we develop, maintain and support Katip Otomasyonu and İSG Asistan under one roof. On the network security side, as an XLog Firewall reseller we provide institutions with firewall and Law 5651 logging solutions.
about.missionText: To free OHS professionals from paperwork and manual tracking, and to speed up their daily work with compliant, reliable and easy-to-use software.
about.visionText: To become the first software company that comes to mind in occupational health & safety in Türkiye, and to bring our products to international markets.
about.valuesText: Data privacy, regulatory compliance, simplicity, reliability, continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.

katip.name: Katip Otomasyonu
katip.short: A browser extension that automates assignment, contract and reporting tasks on the İSG-KATİP platform.
katip.description: Katip Otomasyonu is a Chrome extension that automates the assignment, contract and reporting tasks normally performed one by one on the İSG-KATİP platform. For occupational safety specialists, workplace physicians and other health personnel, it turns hours of repetitive work into minutes.

isgAsistan.name: İSG Asistan
isgAsistan.tagline: Cloud-based management platform for OHS service providers
isgAsistan.short: From company and employee tracking to document generation, accounting and field planning — every OHS process on a single panel.
isgAsistan.description: İSG Asistan is a cloud-based management platform that brings the daily work of an OHS service provider onto a single panel. Instead of scattered spreadsheets and separate programs, companies, employees, documents, accounting and field planning are all managed in one place. It is web-based and requires no installation.

xlog.name: XLog Firewall
xlog.short: A UTM firewall that protects your corporate network and keeps log records compliant with Law 5651. Arkaya is an XLog Firewall reseller.
xlog.description: XLog Firewall is a UTM firewall appliance that protects your corporate network against attacks and keeps log records in line with Turkish Law No. 5651. All log records are signed with a TÜBİTAK Time Stamp and stored on the device. It is managed through a web interface available in Turkish and English.
xlog.resellerNote: Arkaya is an XLog Firewall reseller. Get in touch with us to determine the right model for your organization, and for the sales and installation process.

featuresDetailed.title: Firewall
featuresDetailed.description: Blocks attacks aimed at your network before they reach your devices. Port scans, SYN attacks and many similar attack types are prevented automatically.

featuresDetailed.title: IPS / IDS
featuresDetailed.description: Every packet is inspected for malicious content before entering the network. Potential threats are stopped and temporarily quarantined against repeat attempts. The dynamic signature database is continuously updated.

featuresDetailed.title: Web Filtering
featuresDetailed.description: Using the blacklists already available on the device, you can block the sites you do not want your users to visit.

featuresDetailed.title: HTTPS Filtering
featuresDetailed.description: Block or allow unwanted HTTPS addresses down to sub-addresses in just a few clicks — with no certificate and no proxy required.

featuresDetailed.title: Hotspot
featuresDetailed.description: Authenticate users via national ID, SMS, LDAP, hotel systems or third-party software before granting internet access, and keep log records compliant with Law 5651.

featuresDetailed.title: Rate Limiting
featuresDetailed.description: Prevents users on your network from consuming excessive traffic and caps their speed, keeping the connection comfortable for everyone.

featuresDetailed.title: Interface Management
featuresDetailed.description: View network alerts, change settings, and block or allow with a single click from a web interface available in Turkish and English.

featuresDetailed.title: Automatic Updates
featuresDetailed.description: The software updates itself automatically; malicious and illegal-content addresses are blocked without intervention. Staying on current versions keeps your network safe.

featuresDetailed.title: VPN / SSL VPN
featuresDetailed.description: Merge your remote branches over VPN and remove the physical distance between your networks. With SSL VPN, join your network from your computer instantly over an encrypted connection.

featuresDetailed.title: Link Bonding
featuresDetailed.description: Where a single internet connection is not enough, it combines multiple lines into what behaves as one and increases your effective speed.

featuresDetailed.title: Link Failover
featuresDetailed.description: Run multiple internet lines in a redundant setup that takes over when your connection drops, preventing outages.

featuresDetailed.title: Logging / Signing
featuresDetailed.description: All log records kept on the system are signed with a TÜBİTAK Time Stamp and stored on the device.
